scientific_integrity: Universal proof is analytical. Exact-rational finite experiments corroborate only tested cases, not the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Applies to normalized generic cross-polytope monotone-path coordinates in the ambient Euclidean metric; no assertion for arbitrary affine realizations, nongeneric objectives, John ellipsoids or complete norm spectra. Residual bibliographic uncertainty and no independent mathematical audit.
title: Two antipodal vertices determine the Euclidean outer sphere of every generic cross-polytope monotone-path polytope
